title: Patch: Recruit takes the first card that can actually land, not the first that matches
notes: R4238000: a Recruit passes over a matching card no zone takes (its row full, a named lane taken, a GIGA with no fit, the far half of a slashed board) and summons the first that can land; R690 reads those alone; Recruit N rechecks each scan; recruitAll lists the cards that land as it starts. Engine: effects/summon.rs, whose read query::recruit_takes C #1 Curse of the Forgotten Classic's Radiant now names its forced attacker by (its old reading kept as script_v0_6_7e in KEPT_SCRIPTS). classify stage 2 finds one unforced game of 200 that plays differently: C #90 In Too Deep's Recruit, with a full unit row, now sets S+ #54 Pneumatic Drill from beneath two Units, so S+ #54 is claimed with --plays. Replays a Recruit now changes are refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: Recruit skips cards it can't place
changes: Recruit now skips a card it can't place and takes the next matching card that fits: with your unit row full, it sets the Trap below your top Unit.
A Recruit of several cards takes the next card that fits each time, rather than stopping at the first one that doesn't.
fixes: Curse of the Forgotten Classic's Radiant face: the Unit its Recruit takes past a newer X-cost card now attacks the enemy hero, as its text says.
